hints.title: Core Idea
hints.text: A self-contained substring must contain all occurrences of every character present within it, and cannot equal the full string.

hints.title: Anchor Boundaries
hints.text: A valid left boundary must coincide with the first occurrence of some character. Precompute first and last index positions for every distinct letter.

hints.title: Window Validity
hints.text: Starting at each candidate left boundary, expand rightwards while updating the required last occurrence. If any character has an earlier appearance before the left boundary, break.

hints.title: Implementation

complexity.notes: Testing at most 26 candidate left anchors across the string length.
complexity.whyNaiveFails: Evaluating all O(n^2) substrings with full character scans takes O(n^3) time.
complexity.spaceTimeTradeoff: O(1) extra space for 26 character first and last indices.
complexity.interviewerExpectation: Notice that candidate left borders must coincide with character first occurrences.
